issues.description: default_raise and stale 3.9-compat comments left behind after kw_only_dataclass removal
issues.detail: chia/wallet/wallet_request_types.py still contains `default_raise` and a comment explicitly stating it exists 'for < 3.10 compatibility'. With 3.9 dropped and native kw_only dataclasses, these defaults_factory hacks should be removed or at least the misleading comments cleaned up. Otherwise future readers will be confused about why required fields are using default_factory=default_raise.

issues.description: test-install-scripts.yml leaves `dnf search` in production CI step
issues.detail: The new Amazon and Rocky prep steps run `dnf search python3.12` before installing. `dnf search` is a diagnostic command that produces noisy output and serves no functional purpose in CI. It should be removed; if it was intended for debugging during PR development, it shouldn't land.

issues.description: install.sh version check still allows Python 3.7-3.9 despite 3.10 minimum
issues.detail: The error message was updated to say '>= 3.10 and < 3.13.0', but the actual guard remains `PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7`. A user with Python 3.7, 3.8, or 3.9 will pass this check and proceed to install, only to fail later. The condition should be `-lt 10` to match the new minimum.

issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 globally ignored with TODO instead of incremental fix
issues.detail: The PR description states Union/Optional should now be migrated to PEP 604 syntax, but ruff.toml ignores UP007/UP035/UP045 wholesale with a 'TODO: Remove these' note. This defers the actual migration indefinitely and risks the TODO never being addressed. Consider per-file-ignores or a tracked issue link.

issues.description: itertools not verified imported in test_priority_mutex.py
issues.detail: The change replaces `zip(ordered, ordered[1:])` with `itertools.pairwise(ordered)`, which requires `import itertools` at module scope. The diff doesn't show the import being added; if it isn't already present in the file the test will raise NameError. Worth confirming the import exists.

issues.description: Stale 3.9 compatibility comment remains in conditions.py
issues.detail: The `continue` statement was uncovered from `# pragma: no cover` but the surrounding context (and other files like wallet_request_types.py) still references Python 3.9 quirks. Worth a sweep for similar stale '< 3.10' or '3.9' comments throughout the codebase as part of this drop.

review.summary: This PR cleanly drops Python 3.9 support across CI, install scripts, packaging, and version-gated dataclass shims. Main concerns: install.sh still has a stale `-lt 7` minor-version guard that lets 3.7-3.9 through, and the new dnf prep steps include a leftover `dnf search` diagnostic. The wholesale ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 ignore defers the Union/Optional migration that the PR description explicitly motivates, and several `default_raise` shims plus comments referencing '< 3.10 compatibility' should be cleaned up now that they're moot.
